dependencies.name: nativewebp (engine package)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — pure-Go, no cgo, so it fits the CGO_ENABLED=0 cross-compile this family of apps requires. Writes lossless WebP only; there's no pure-Go lossy WebP encoder without cgo. Not a separate install; listed for transparency about what this app is built on.

dependencies.name: golang.org/x/image (bmp, tiff, webp, draw)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — decodes BMP/TIFF/WebP and does the quality resize. Not a separate install.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.
